metadata.description: Skills for ODH/RHOAI component onboarding and DevOps automation, developed by the opendatahub-io aiops-infra team.

plugins.description: Interactively collects ODH/RHOAI component onboarding parameters, generates a validated component_onboarding_details.yaml, and creates or updates a Jira ticket with the YAML attached. When no Jira URL is provided, automatically creates a new ticket by cloning the product-specific onboarding template.
plugins.name: aiops-onboarding
